summary: Guest entitlement primitive: signed guest cookie + guest/IP quota gate + stable ip-name
description: Foundation, no UI, no route wiring. Add src/lib/guest.ts that: mints/verifies a signed 'guru_guest' cookie token (HMAC over a random id, secret from env); exposes a one-shot entitlement check reusing the fixed-window limiter concept from src/lib/ip-rate-limit.ts (in-memory, per-process, single 'next start' — same topology caveat) for BOTH the guest-token count (1-free-question cap) and a guest:<ip> throttle (defeats cookie-clearing); and derives a STABLE deterministic ip-name pseudonym from the IP (e.g. adjective-noun hash) for admin display so raw IP isn't the primary label. Do NOT touch users/rate_limits DB tables (FK to users can't key anon callers — see ip-rate-limit.ts header). Verdict: {allowed, retryAfterSeconds, token, ipName}.
